mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.plot_id, r.scout_time, r.image_url, r.image_hash, r.plant_part, r.symptom_text, r.severity, r.diagnosis_name, r.confidence, r.risk_level, r.diagnosis_basis, r.diagnosis_source, r.knowledge_id, r.suggestion_source, r.dosage_guard_hit, r.report_time, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, p.plot_name as plot_name, p.crop_type as crop_type from tz_scouting_record r left join tz_plot p on p.plot_id = r.plot_id
mapper.select: select r.record_id, r.plot_id, r.scout_time, r.image_url, r.image_hash, r.plant_part, r.symptom_text, r.severity, r.diagnosis_name, r.confidence, r.risk_level, r.diagnosis_basis, r.diagnosis_source, r.knowledge_id, r.suggestion, r.suggestion_source, r.dosage_guard_hit, r.report_text, r.report_time, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, p.plot_name as plot_name, p.crop_type as crop_type from tz_scouting_record r left join tz_plot p on p.plot_id = r.plot_id where r.record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: insert into tz_scouting_record ( plot_id, scout_time, image_url, image_hash, plant_part, symptom_text, severity, diagnosis_name, confidence, risk_level, diagnosis_basis, diagnosis_source, knowledge_id, suggestion, suggestion_source, dosage_guard_hit, report_text, report_time, status, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{plotId}, #{scoutTime}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageHash}, #{plantPart}, #{symptomText}, #{severity}, #{diagnosisName}, #{confidence}, #{riskLevel}, #{diagnosisBasis}, #{diagnosisSource}, #{knowledgeId}, #{suggestion}, #{suggestionSource}, #{dosageGuardHit}, #{reportText}, #{reportTime}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from tz_scouting_record where record_id in
#{recordId}
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalRecords, sum(case when date_format(scout_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m') then 1 else 0 end) as monthRecords, sum(case when risk_level = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as highRiskRecords, sum(case when diagnosis_name is not null and diagnosis_name != '' then 1 else 0 end) as diagnosedRecords, sum(case when dosage_guard_hit = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as dosageGuardHits, ifnull(round(avg(confidence), 1), 0) as avgConfidence from tz_scouting_record
select ifnull(diagnosis_name, '未诊断') as `name`, count(1) as `value` from tz_scouting_record group by diagnosis_name order by `value` desc limit 10
select case risk_level when '1' then '低风险' when '2' then '中风险' when '3' then '高风险' else '未评估' end as `name`, count(1) as `value` from tz_scouting_record group by risk_level order by risk_level

select case diagnosis_source when 'preset' then '预置映射' when 'llm' then '大模型' when 'fallback' then '降级结果' when 'manual' then '人工录入' else '未诊断' end as `name`, count(1) as `value` from tz_scouting_record group by diagnosis_source order by `value` desc

select date_format(scout_time, '%m-%d') as `date`, count(1) as `count` from tz_scouting_record where scout_time is not null and scout_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(scout_time, '%m-%d') order by min(scout_time)
